cases.text: This is some test. BEGIN-REDACT This text should be redacted. END-REDACT This is outside the text.

spans.text: BEGIN-REDACT This text should be redacted. END-REDACT

expect.filtered_text: This is some test. {{{REDACTED-section}}} This is outside the text.

rationale: Everything between the start and end patterns is one span, including the delimiters.
The patterns come from the policy, so the case is self-contained.

cases.text: This is some test. BEGIN-REDACT This text should be redacted. This is outside the text.

expect.filtered_text: This is some test. BEGIN-REDACT This text should be redacted. This is outside the text.

rationale: With no end pattern present, the section runs to the end of the document. Pinned because the alternative, matching nothing, would silently leak the section this filter exists to remove.
